notes.title: A FREE GIFT
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

I am happy to inform you, that I would like to change the price of this game to 0, because I wish everyone in the earth owns this game as a gift from me out of good-will.

This game is now free on Itch.io, and switching price on Steam is still on progress.

May each human in the world has a healthy brain without dementia!
